_comment: Protein coverage per pLM arm AFTER the M-12 cut to <=2000 residues. Cached so the UpSet figure regenerates offline; see embedding_key_coverage.json for the pre-cut state.
state: POST-CUT. esm2_3b is the completed working copy (542,187 keys before the cut); all other arms measured from the Zenodo deposit. The physical rewrite is LRZ job 5734016; these counts are what that job will produce.
result: 13 of 15 arms hold the full 540,881. clean and esm1b hold 526,871 (97.41%) because ESM-1b's learned positional embeddings cap at 1022 tokens and CLEAN is built on ESM-1b, inheriting its coverage exactly. That 14,010-protein shortfall is DOCUMENTED, not fixed -- cutting to 1022 would cost every arm those proteins to accommodate one model.
quadratic_note: A pair needs BOTH proteins, so 97.41% protein coverage is ~94.9% of pairs for clean/esm1b. Disclose wherever either appears in a ranking.
patterns_note: key = bitmask over `models`; value = proteins with exactly that membership.
